scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./packages/* run build && pnpm --filter ./database run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/* run build
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply instagram-widget-db --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:widget: pnpm build:widget && wrangler pages deploy apps/widget/dist --project-name alfsight-widget --branch main
scripts.deploy:dashboard: pnpm build:dashboard && wrangler pages deploy apps/dashboard/dist --project-name alfsight-dashboard --branch main
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm build:web && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name alfsight --branch main
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm deploy:api && pnpm deploy:widget && pnpm deploy:dashboard && pnpm deploy:web
